sanskrit: daśa nāmasahasrāṇi vedeṣv āha pitāmahaḥ śarvasya śāstreṣu tathā daśa nāmaśatāni vai
english: In the Vedas the Grandsire proclaimed ten thousand names of Śarva, and in the scriptures, likewise, a thousand names.

sanskrit: guhyānīmāni nāmāni taṇḍir bhagavato 'cyuta devaprasādād deveśa purā prāha mahātmane
english: These secret names of the Blessed One, O Acyuta, O lord of the gods, the sage Taṇḍi declared of old, by the grace of the deity, to that great-souled one.

sanskrit: vāsudeva uvāca tataḥ sa prayato bhūtvā mama tāta yudhiṣṭhira prāñjaliḥ prāha viprarṣir nāmasaṃhāram āditaḥ
english: Vāsudeva said: Then, my dear Yudhiṣṭhira, that brahmin-sage, having purified himself, with palms joined in reverence, recited to me the litany of names from the beginning.

sanskrit: upamanyur uvāca brahmaproktair ṛṣiproktair vedavedāṅgasaṃbhavaiḥ sarvalokeṣu vikhyātaiḥ sthāṇuṃ stoṣyāmi nāmabhiḥ
english: Upamanyu said: With names declared by Brahmā, declared by the seers, born of the Vedas and their auxiliary sciences, renowned throughout all the worlds, I shall praise Sthāṇu.

sanskrit: mahadbhir vihitaiḥ satyaiḥ siddhaiḥ sarvārthasādhakaiḥ ṛṣiṇā taṇḍinā bhaktyā kṛtair devakṛtātmanā
english: With names ordained by the great ones, true, perfected, accomplishing every aim, fashioned in devotion by the sage Taṇḍi, whose self was made one with the god.

sanskrit: yathoktair lokavikhyātair munibhis tattvadarśibhiḥ pravaraṃ prathamaṃ svargyaṃ sarvabhūtahitaṃ śubham śrutaiḥ sarvatra jagati brahmalokāvatāritaiḥ
english: With names handed down as spoken, famed throughout the world, given by sages who see the truth — supreme, primordial, leading to heaven, the welfare of all beings, auspicious, heard everywhere in the universe, brought down from the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit: yat tad rahasyaṃ paramaṃ brahmaproktaṃ sanātanam vakṣye yadukulaśreṣṭha śṛṇuṣvāvahito mama
english: That supreme mystery, eternal, declared by Brahmā, I shall now speak, O best of the Yadu line; listen to me with full attention.

sanskrit: paratvena bhavaṃ devaṃ bhaktas tvaṃ parameśvaram tena te śrāvayiṣyāmi yat tad brahma sanātanam
english: As one devoted, you hold the god Bhava to be the Supreme, the highest Lord; therefore I shall cause you to hear that eternal Absolute.

sanskrit: na śakyaṃ vistarāt kṛtsnaṃ vaktuṃ śarvasya kena cit yuktenāpi vibhūtīnām api varṣaśatair api
english: No one is able to tell in full detail the glories of Śarva — not even one wholly absorbed in yoga, not even in a hundred years.

sanskrit: yasyādir madhyam antaś ca surair api na gamyate kas tasya śaknuyād vaktuṃ guṇān kārtsnyena mādhava
english: He whose beginning, middle, and end not even the gods can reach — who, O Mādhava, could tell his attributes in their entirety?

sanskrit: kiṃ tu devasya mahataḥ saṃkṣiptārthapadākṣaram śaktitaś caritaṃ vakṣye prasādāt tasya caiva hi
english: Yet of the mighty god, in words and syllables compressed in meaning, I shall recount his deeds as best I can, and by his grace alone.

sanskrit: aprāpyeha tato 'nujñāṃ na śakyaḥ stotum īśvaraḥ yadā tenābhyanujñātaḥ stuvaty eva sadā bhavam
english: Without first obtaining his sanction, the Lord cannot here be praised; only when granted leave by him may one ever praise Bhava.

sanskrit: anādinidhanasyāhaṃ sarvayoner mahātmanaḥ nāmnāṃ kaṃ cit samuddeśaṃ vakṣye hy avyaktayoninaḥ
english: Of him without beginning or end, the source of all, the great-souled one whose origin is unmanifest, I shall set forth some portion of his names.

sanskrit: varadasya vareṇyasya viśvarūpasya dhīmataḥ śṛṇu nāmasamuddeśaṃ yad uktaṃ padmayoninā
english: Of the giver of boons, the most excellent, the cosmic-formed, the wise one — hear the enumeration of names that was spoken by the Lotus-born.

sanskrit: daśa nāmasahasrāṇi yāny āha prapitāmahaḥ tāni nirmathya manasā dadhno ghṛtam ivoddhṛtam
english: The ten thousand names that the great Grandsire declared — churning these in his mind, he drew them forth as clarified butter is drawn from curds.

sanskrit: gireḥ sāraṃ yathā hema puṣpāt sāraṃ yathā madhu ghṛtāt sāraṃ yathā maṇḍas tathaitat sāram uddhṛtam
english: As gold is the essence of the mountain, as honey is the essence of the flower, as cream is the essence of clarified butter, so this essence was drawn forth.

sanskrit: sarvapāpmāpaham idaṃ caturvedasamanvitam prayatnenādhigantavyaṃ dhāryaṃ ca prayatātmanā śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caiva rakṣoghnaṃ pāvanaṃ mahat
english: This litany, which removes all sin and is joined with the four Vedas, is to be mastered with effort and held fast by one of disciplined soul — bringing peace, fostering prosperity, slaying demons, purifying, and great.

sanskrit: idaṃ bhaktāya dātavyaṃ śraddadhānāstikāya ca nāśraddadhānarūpāya nāstikāyājitātmane
english: This is to be given to one who is devoted, faithful, and a believer — never to one without faith, to an unbeliever, or to one whose self is unconquered.

sanskrit: yaś cābhyasūyate devaṃ bhūtātmānaṃ pinākinam sa kṛṣṇa narakaṃ yāti saha pūrvaiḥ sahānugaiḥ
english: And whoever reviles the god, the Self of all beings, the wielder of the Pināka bow — he, O Kṛṣṇa, goes to hell together with his forebears and his followers.

sanskrit: idaṃ dhyānam idaṃ yogam idaṃ dhyeyam anuttamam idaṃ japyam idaṃ jñānaṃ rahasyam idam uttamam idaṃ jñātvāntakāle 'pi gacched dhi paramāṃ gatim
english: This is meditation, this is yoga, this is the unsurpassed object of contemplation; this is the prayer to be murmured, this is knowledge, this the supreme mystery; knowing this, even at the hour of death one attains the highest goal.

sanskrit: pavitraṃ maṅgalaṃ puṇyaṃ kalyāṇam idam uttamam nigadiṣye mahābāho stavānām uttamaṃ stavam
english: Pure, auspicious, meritorious, blessed, and supreme — this I shall now recite, O mighty-armed one: the highest of all hymns of praise.

sanskrit: idaṃ brahmā purā kṛtvā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ sarvastavānāṃ divyānāṃ rājatve samakalpayat
english: Brahmā, the Grandsire of all the worlds, having composed this of old, appointed it to sovereignty over all the celestial hymns.

sanskrit: tadāprabhṛti caivāyam īśvarasya mahātmanaḥ stavarājeti vikhyāto jagaty amarapūjitaḥ brahmalokād ayaṃ caiva stavarājo 'vatāritaḥ
english: From that time onward this hymn of the great-souled Lord has been renowned in the world as the King of Hymns, honored by the immortals; and this King of Hymns was brought down from the world of Brahmā.

sanskrit: yasmāt taṇḍiḥ purā prāha tena taṇḍikṛto 'bhavat svargāc caivātra bhūlokaṃ taṇḍinā hy avatāritaḥ
english: Because Taṇḍi proclaimed it of old, it came to be called the work of Taṇḍi; and from heaven to this earthly world it was indeed brought down by Taṇḍi.

sanskrit: sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam nigadiṣye mahābāho stavānām uttamaṃ stavam
english: Auspicious among all auspicious things, destroying every sin — this I shall recite, O mighty-armed one: the highest of all hymns.

sanskrit: brahmaṇām api yad brahma parāṇām api yat param tejasām api yat tejas tapasām api yat tapaḥ
english: He who is the Absolute even of the absolutes, the supreme even of the supreme, the radiance even of radiances, the austerity even of austerities;

sanskrit: śāntīnām api yā śāntir dyutīnām api yā dyutiḥ dāntānām api yo dānto dhīmatām api yā ca dhīḥ
english: The peace even of those at peace, the brilliance even of the brilliant, the self-controlled even among the self-controlled, the wisdom even of the wise;

sanskrit: devānām api yo devo munīnām api yo muniḥ yajñānām api yo yajñaḥ śivānām api yaḥ śivaḥ
english: The god even of the gods, the sage even of the sages, the sacrifice even of sacrifices, the auspicious even of auspicious things;

sanskrit: rudrāṇām api yo rudraḥ prabhuḥ prabhavatām api yoginām api yo yogī kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam
english: The Rudra even of the Rudras, the lord even of the mighty, the yogin even of yogins, and the cause of all causes;

sanskrit: yato lokāḥ saṃbhavanti na bhavanti yataḥ punaḥ sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya harasyāmitatejasaḥ
english: From whom the worlds arise and into whom they cease to be — of Hara, who has become the Self of all beings, of measureless splendor.

sanskrit: aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu nāmnāṃ śarvasya me śṛṇu yac chrutvā manujaśreṣṭha sarvān kāmān avāpsyasi
english: Now hear from me the thousand-and-eight names of Śarva, on hearing which, O best of men, you shall obtain all your desires.

sanskrit: sthiraḥ sthāṇuḥ prabhur bhānuḥ pravaro varado varaḥ sarvātmā sarvavikhyātaḥ sarvaḥ sarvakaro bhavaḥ
english: The Steadfast, the Pillar, the Lord, the Radiant, the Most Excellent, the Boon-giver, the Best; the Self of all, the All-renowned, the All, the Maker of all, Bhava the Existent.

sanskrit: jaṭī carmī śikhaṇḍī ca sarvāṅgaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ hariś ca hariṇākṣaś ca sarvabhūtaharaḥ prabhuḥ
english: The Matted-haired, the Hide-clad, the Crested; the All-bodied, the Source of all becoming; Hari, the Doe-eyed, the Lord who withdraws all beings.

sanskrit: pravṛttiś ca nivṛttiś ca niyataḥ śāśvato dhruvaḥ śmaśānacārī bhagavān khacaro gocaro 'rdanaḥ
english: Engagement and Disengagement; the Constant, the Eternal, the Fixed; the Haunter of cremation grounds, the Blessed One, the Sky-rover, the Earth-rover, the Tormentor.

sanskrit: abhivādyo mahākarmā tapasvī bhūtabhāvanaḥ unmattaveśapracchannaḥ sarvalokaprajāpatiḥ
english: The One to be saluted, of mighty deeds, the Ascetic, the Nourisher of beings; Hidden in the guise of a madman, the Lord of all creatures in every world.

sanskrit: mahārūpo mahākāyaḥ sarvarūpo mahāyaśāḥ mahātmā sarvabhūtaś ca virūpo vāmano manuḥ
english: Of great form, of mighty frame, of every form, of great renown; the Great-souled, the All-pervading, the Misshapen, the Dwarf, the Man.

sanskrit: lokapālo 'ntarhitātmā prasādo hayagardabhiḥ pavitraś ca mahāṃś caiva niyamo niyamāśrayaḥ
english: The Guardian of the world, the Hidden-souled, Serene Grace, He of horse and ass; the Pure, the Mighty, Discipline itself, and the Refuge of discipline.

sanskrit: sarvakarmā svayaṃbhūś ca ādir ādikaro nidhiḥ sahasrākṣo virūpākṣaḥ somo nakṣatrasādhakaḥ
english: The Doer of all deeds, the Self-existent, the Beginning, the First Maker, the Treasure-store; the Thousand-eyed, the Strange-eyed, Soma, the Marshaller of the stars.

sanskrit: candrasūryagatiḥ ketur graho grahapatir varaḥ adrir adryālayaḥ kartā mṛgabāṇārpaṇo 'naghaḥ
english: The Path of moon and sun, the Comet, the Seizing Planet, the Lord of planets, the Excellent; the Mountain, the Mountain-dweller, the Maker, He who loosed the arrow at the deer-form, the Sinless.

sanskrit: mahātapā ghoratapā adīno dīnasādhakaḥ saṃvatsarakaro mantraḥ pramāṇaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ
english: Of great austerity, of terrible austerity, the Undejected, the Helper of the wretched; the Maker of the year, the Sacred Formula, the Measure, the Supreme Austerity.

sanskrit: yogī yojyo mahābījo mahāretā mahātapāḥ suvarṇaretāḥ sarvajñaḥ subījo vṛṣavāhanaḥ
english: The Yogin, the One to be united with, the Great Seed, the Great-seeded, of great austerity; He of golden seed, the All-knowing, of goodly seed, the Bull-borne.

sanskrit: daśabāhus tv animiṣo nīlakaṇṭha umāpatiḥ viśvarūpaḥ svayaṃśreṣṭho balavīro balo gaṇaḥ
english: The Ten-armed, the Unblinking, the Blue-throated, the Husband of Umā; the Cosmic-formed, the Self-supreme, the Mighty Hero, the Strong, the Host.

sanskrit: gaṇakartā gaṇapatir digvāsāḥ kāmya eva ca pavitraṃ paramaṃ mantraḥ sarvabhāvakaro haraḥ
english: The Maker of hosts, the Lord of hosts, the Sky-clad, and the Desirable; the Pure, the Supreme, the Sacred Formula, Hara who brings every state of being to pass.

sanskrit: kamaṇḍaludharo dhanvī bāṇahastaḥ kapālavān aśanī śataghnī khaḍgī paṭṭiśī cāyudhī mahān
english: Bearer of the water-pot, the Bowman, the Arrow-handed, He who holds a skull; armed with the thunderbolt, the śataghnī, the sword, and the spear — the Weaponed, the Great.

sanskrit: sruvahastaḥ surūpaś ca tejas tejaskaro nidhiḥ uṣṇīṣī ca suvaktraś ca udagro vinatas tathā
english: The Ladle-handed, the Fair-formed, Radiance, the Maker of radiance, the Treasure-store; the Turbaned, the Fair-faced, the Lofty, and likewise the Bowed.

sanskrit: dīrghaś ca harikeśaś ca sutīrthaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca sṛgālarūpaḥ sarvārtho muṇḍaḥ kuṇḍī kamaṇḍaluḥ
english: The Tall, the Tawny-haired, the Goodly Ford, and the Dark One; the Jackal-formed, the All-purposed, the Shaven-headed, the Ringed, He of the water-pot.

sanskrit: ajaś ca mṛgarūpaś ca gandhadhārī kapardy api ūrdhvaretā ūrdhvaliṅga ūrdhvaśāyī nabhastalaḥ
english: The Unborn, the Deer-formed, the Bearer of fragrance, He of the matted braid; of upward-flowing seed, with phallus raised, lying on high, the very vault of heaven.

sanskrit: trijaṭaś cīravāsāś ca rudraḥ senāpatir vibhuḥ ahaścaro 'tha naktaṃ ca tigmamanyuḥ suvarcasaḥ
english: The Triple-braided, the Rag-clad, Rudra, the Army-commander, the All-pervading; the Day-rover and the Night-rover, of fierce wrath, of brilliant splendor.

sanskrit: gajahā daityahā loko lokadhātā guṇākaraḥ siṃhaśārdūlarūpaś ca ārdracarmāmbarāvṛtaḥ
english: Slayer of the elephant, slayer of demons, the World itself, the Upholder of the world, the Mine of virtues; of the form of lion and tiger, wrapped in a garment of fresh hide.

sanskrit: kālayogī mahānādaḥ sarvavāsaś catuṣpathaḥ niśācaraḥ pretacārī bhūtacārī maheśvaraḥ
english: The Yogin of Time, the Great Roar, the Dwelling-place of all, the Crossroads; the Night-rover, the Wanderer among ghosts, the Wanderer among spirits, the Great Lord.

sanskrit: bahubhūto bahudhanaḥ sarvādhāro 'mito gatiḥ nṛtyapriyo nityanarto nartakaḥ sarvalāsakaḥ
english: Of many forms, of many treasures, the Support of all, of boundless course; Lover of the dance, ever-dancing, the Dancer, the Sporter of all.

sanskrit: ghoro mahātapāḥ pāśo nityo giricaro nabhaḥ sahasrahasto vijayo vyavasāyo hy aninditaḥ
english: The Terrible, of great austerity, the Noose, the Eternal, the Mountain-rover, the Sky; the Thousand-handed, the Victorious, Resolve itself, the Blameless.

sanskrit: amarṣaṇo marṣaṇātmā yajñahā kāmanāśanaḥ dakṣayajñāpahārī ca susaho madhyamas tathā
english: The Unforbearing, the Forbearing-souled, the Destroyer of the sacrifice, the Slayer of desire; the Despoiler of Dakṣa's sacrifice, the All-enduring, and the Mean between extremes.

sanskrit: tejopahārī balahā mudito 'rtho jito varaḥ gambhīraghoṣo gambhīro gambhīrabalavāhanaḥ
english: Robber of radiance, slayer of might, the Joyful, the Aim, the Conquered, the Best; of deep voice, the Profound, He whose strength and mount are profound.

sanskrit: nyagrodharūpo nyagrodho vṛkṣakarṇasthitir vibhuḥ tīkṣṇatāpaś ca haryaśvaḥ sahāyaḥ karmakālavit
english: Of the banyan's form, the Banyan, abiding in the tree's hollow, the All-pervading; of sharp heat, the Tawny-horsed, the Companion, the Knower of the time of action.

sanskrit: viṣṇuprasādito yajñaḥ samudro vaḍavāmukhaḥ hutāśanasahāyaś ca praśāntātmā hutāśanaḥ
english: Propitiated by Viṣṇu, the Sacrifice, the Ocean, the Mare's-mouth fire; the Ally of the fire that eats oblations, the Tranquil-souled, the Oblation-eater himself.

sanskrit: ugratejā mahātejā jayo vijayakālavit jyotiṣām ayanaṃ siddhiḥ saṃdhir vigraha eva ca
english: Of fierce radiance, of great radiance, the Victory, the Knower of the hour of triumph; the Pathway of the lights, Attainment, Union, and also Strife.

sanskrit: śikhī daṇḍī jaṭī jvālī mūrtijo mūrdhago balī vaiṇavī paṇavī tālī kālaḥ kālakaṭaṃkaṭaḥ
english: The Crested, the Staff-bearer, the Matted-haired, the Flaming; Born of form, Crowning the head, the Strong; the Flute-player, the Drummer, the Cymbalist, Time itself, the Kālakaṭaṃkaṭa.

sanskrit: nakṣatravigrahavidhir guṇavṛddhir layo 'gamaḥ prajāpatir diśābāhur vibhāgaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ
english: The Ordainer of the array of stars, the Increase of qualities, Dissolution, the Inaccessible; the Lord of creatures, He whose arms are the quarters, the Apportioning, the Face-turned-everywhere.

sanskrit: vimocanaḥ suragaṇo hiraṇyakavacodbhavaḥ meḍhrajo balacārī ca mahācārī stutas tathā
english: The Liberator, the Host of the gods, Sprung from golden armor; Born of the loins, the Wanderer in strength, the Great Wanderer, and likewise the Praised.

sanskrit: sarvatūryaninādī ca sarvavādyaparigrahaḥ vyālarūpo bilāvāsī hemamālī taraṃgavit
english: Sounding all the trumpets, the Possessor of every instrument; of serpent form, dwelling in caverns, the Gold-garlanded, the Knower of the waves.

sanskrit: tridaśas trikāladhṛk karmasarvabandhavimocanaḥ bandhanas tv asurendrāṇāṃ yudhi śatruvināśanaḥ
english: The Thrice-ten gods, the Holder of the three times, the Looser of every bond of action; yet the Binding of the chiefs of the asuras, the Destroyer of foes in battle.

sanskrit: sāṃkhyaprasādo durvāsāḥ sarvasādhuniṣevitaḥ praskandano vibhāgaś ca atulyo yajñabhāgavit
english: The Grace of Sāṃkhya, the Ill-clad, the Served by all the good; the Onrushing, the Apportioning, the Incomparable, the Knower of the sacrificial share.

sanskrit: sarvāvāsaḥ sarvacārī durvāsā vāsavo 'maraḥ hemo hemakaro yajñaḥ sarvadhārī dharottamaḥ
english: The Dwelling of all, the Wanderer everywhere, the Ill-clad, the Wealth-giver, the Immortal; the Golden, the Maker of gold, the Sacrifice, the Upholder of all, the Supreme Sustainer.

sanskrit: lohitākṣo mahākṣaś ca vijayākṣo viśāradaḥ saṃgraho nigrahaḥ kartā sarpacīranivāsanaḥ
english: The Red-eyed, the Great-eyed, the Eye of victory, the Skilled; the Gathering-up, the Restraint, the Maker, Clothed in the slough of serpents.

sanskrit: mukhyo 'mukhyaś ca dehaś ca deharddhiḥ sarvakāmadaḥ sarvakālaprasādaś ca subalo balarūpadhṛk
english: The Foremost and the Not-foremost, the Body and the Body's increase, the Granter of every desire; Gracious at all times, of goodly strength, bearing the form of strength.

sanskrit: ākāśanidhirūpaś ca nipātī uragaḥ khagaḥ raudrarūpo 'ṃśur ādityo vasuraśmiḥ suvarcasī
english: Of the form of the treasure-store that is space, the Down-striker, the Serpent, the Sky-goer; of fierce form, the Ray, the Sun, He whose beams are wealth, of brilliant splendor.

sanskrit: vasuvego mahāvego manovego niśācaraḥ sarvāvāsī śriyāvāsī upadeśakaro haraḥ
english: Swift as wealth, of mighty speed, swift as thought, the Night-rover; Dwelling in all, dwelling with Fortune, Hara the giver of instruction.

sanskrit: munir ātmapatir loke saṃbhojyaś ca sahasradaḥ pakṣī ca pakṣirūpī ca atidīpto viśāṃ patiḥ
english: The Sage, the Lord of his own self in the world, the One to be feasted, the Thousandfold giver; the Bird and the Bird-formed, the Surpassingly radiant, the Lord of peoples.

sanskrit: unmādo madanākāro arthārthakararomaśaḥ vāmadevaś ca vāmaś ca prāgdakṣiṇyaś ca vāmanaḥ
english: Frenzy, of the form of passion, the Maker of wealth from wealth, the Hairy one; Vāmadeva and the Lovely, He who faces east and south, the Dwarf.

sanskrit: siddhayogāpahārī ca siddhaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ bhikṣuś ca bhikṣurūpaś ca viṣāṇī mṛdur avyayaḥ
english: The Withdrawer of perfected yoga, the Perfected, the Accomplisher of every aim; the Mendicant and the Mendicant-formed, the Horned, the Gentle, the Imperishable.

sanskrit: mahāseno viśākhaś ca ṣaṣṭibhāgo gavāṃ patiḥ vajrahastaś ca viṣkambhī camūstambhana eva ca
english: The Great-armied, and Viśākha, He of the sixtyfold portion, the Lord of cattle; the Thunderbolt-handed, the Prop, and the Stayer of armies.

sanskrit: ṛtur ṛtukaraḥ kālo madhur madhukaro 'calaḥ vānaspatyo vājaseno nityam āśramapūjitaḥ
english: The Season, the Maker of seasons, Time, the Sweet, the Maker of sweetness, the Unmoving; Sprung from the lord of trees, He of the array of strength, ever honored in the hermitages.

sanskrit: brahmacārī lokacārī sarvacārī sucāravit īśāna īśvaraḥ kālo niśācārī pinākadhṛk
english: The Chaste student, the World-rover, the Wanderer everywhere, the Knower of good conduct; the Ruler, the Lord, Time, the Night-wanderer, the Bearer of the Pināka bow.

sanskrit: nandīśvaraś ca nandī ca nandano nandivardhanaḥ bhagasyākṣinihantā ca kālo brahmavidāṃ varaḥ
english: Nandīśvara and Nandin, the Gladdening, the Increaser of joy; the Slayer of Bhaga's eye, Time, the best of those who know the Absolute.

sanskrit: caturmukho mahāliṅgaś cāruliṅgas tathaiva ca liṅgādhyakṣaḥ surādhyakṣo lokādhyakṣo yugāvahaḥ
english: The Four-faced, of mighty emblem, and likewise of fair emblem; the Overseer of the emblem, the Overseer of the gods, the Overseer of the worlds, the Bearer of the yoke of the ages.

sanskrit: bījādhyakṣo bījakartā adhyātmānugato balaḥ itihāsakaraḥ kalpo gautamo 'tha jaleśvaraḥ
english: The Overseer of the seed, the Maker of the seed, He who attends upon the inmost Self, the Strong; the Maker of legend, the Aeon, Gautama, and the Lord of waters.

sanskrit: dambho hy adambho vaidambho vaśyo vaśyakaraḥ kaviḥ lokakartā paśupatir mahākartā mahauṣadhiḥ
english: Pride and the Prideless, the Conqueror of pride, the Subdued, the Subduer, the Seer; the Maker of the world, the Lord of beasts, the Great Maker, the Mighty Herb.

sanskrit: akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma balavāñ śakra eva ca nītir hy anītiḥ śuddhātmā śuddho mānyo manogatiḥ
english: The Imperishable, the Supreme Absolute, the Mighty, and Śakra himself; Right conduct and Misconduct, the Pure-souled, the Pure, the Honored, the Course of the mind.

sanskrit: bahuprasādaḥ svapano darpaṇo 'tha tv amitrajit vedakāraḥ sūtrakāro vidvān samaramardanaḥ
english: Abundant in grace, the Dreamer, the Mirror, and the Vanquisher of foes; the Maker of the Vedas, the Maker of the aphorisms, the Learned, the Crusher in battle.
